assignments.reason: A clean body (גוף נקי) is the physical state of purity that enables the brain to produce true judgments. The Torah states: 'the brain is according to the food, and when the body is clean, the brain is clear, and then one can produce true judgments, upright guidance.' Its essential nature is bodily purity — a precondition for clear intellect and righteous leadership. While it enables wisdom (Package 1), its essential role in this Torah is as the physical substrate for true judgment (Package 2's domain), and it is explicitly contrasted with the impurity of מותרות (Package 3) that produces distorted judgment.

assignments.node_id: המח ברור. ואזי יכול להוציא משפטי אמת, הנהגות ישרות
assignments.reason: The clear brain that produces true judgments and upright guidance IS the faculty of judgment in its optimal state. Its essential nature is the cognitive clarity that generates משפטי אמת and הנהגות ישרות — both of which are already core nodes in Package 2. This node is the functional description of what Package 2 IS when it operates correctly: the brain, clear of the toxic fumes of excess, producing balanced, non-deviating judgment.

Love and collective unity (אהבה וכללות) IS the quality through which all souls are gathered into the tzaddik (the foundation stone). The Torah concludes with 'אנן בחביבותא תליא' — we depend on love — and this love is what enables the souls (נפשות/אבנים, already in Package 1) to be included within the tzaddik (צדיק הדור, Package 1). Its essential nature is the bond of love that unifies souls, which is the soul-gathering domain of Package 1, not a separate concept. It IS the mechanism by which Package 1's core function operates.

assignments.node_id: המתקה והתקון כנ"ל. ומזה בא בחינת חדי רבי שמעון, הינו בחינת השמחה, שנעשה על ידי הכללות והאהבה, בחינת: "אור צדיקים ישמח":
assignments.reason: This composite node describes sweetening/rectification (המתקה והתיקון) and the resulting joy of Rabbi Shimon (חדי רבי שמעון). Its essential nature is the sweetening of judgments (המתקת הדינים, already in Package 1) expressed through joy. The Torah explicitly links this to 'אור צדיקים ישמח' — the light of the righteous produces joy — and this light is the unified souls (נר/נפש, Package 1) gathered before the tzaddik. Its core domain is the sweetening-function of the supernal intellect, which is Package 1's central purpose.

Repentance proportionate to controversy (לפי התשובה לפי המחלקת) IS the teshuvah-process that controversy generates. Its essential nature is repentance/return (תשובה), and in this Torah, תשובה is inseparable from מחלקת: the teaching states that controversy forces one to examine why they are being opposed, which leads to teshuvah, which generates ספרים. Teshuvah here is not an independent concept but the inner engine of the controversy-to-book process. It belongs in Package 4 as the transformative mechanism within the controversy-and-renewal domain.

Returning to faith in the sages IS the restoration of אמונת חכמים (already the core of Package 2). Its essential nature is faith in the sages — the very same quality that Package 2 is named for. The Torah states: through controversy and teshuvah, one 'returns to faith in the sages.' The destination of the return is Package 2's domain; the process of return is Package 4's domain. But the node itself names the state returned to — faith in sages — which is Package 2.

assignments.node_id: כשיש לה שלמות. ושלמות התורה, היא על־ידי תורה שבעל פה
assignments.reason: The completeness of the Torah through Oral Torah (תורה שבעל פה) IS the culmination of Package 4's process. The Torah states: 'Written Torah has no completeness except through Oral Torah' and 'through the books that are renewed via controversy (ספר/שאלות ותשובות, Package 4), the Torah is completed.' The essential nature of this node is Torah completeness through halakhic literature — the very product of the controversy-book-renewal chain that defines Package 4.

The capacity to receive from supernal wisdom (חכמה עלאה) IS the defining receptive relationship with Package 1's core node. Its essential nature is reception from the supernal intellect — the same domain as חכמה עלאה, לוחות האבן, and אבן שתיה (all Package 1). The Torah states: 'the Torah receives from supernal wisdom' via the stone tablets/foundation stone. This node describes the state of being aligned with Package 1's source.

The ability to bring our judgment to light (להוציא משפטנו לאור) IS the concrete expression of true judgment. Its essential nature is the manifestation of clear, true judgment — the very same quality as משפט, משפטי אמת, and משפטי הנהגות ישרות (all Package 2). The Torah opens with: 'through faith in the sages, one can bring our judgment to light.' This node is the active expression of Package 2's core quality.

assignments.node_id: כל הלמודים שהאדם לומד, צריך שיקבל ויוציא מהם משפטי אמת, שלא יהיה בבחינת משפט מעקל. דהינו, שיקבל וילמד מכל הלמודים שלומד, משפטי הנהגות. שידע איך להתנהג, הן לעצמו, הן לאחרים שמתנהגים לפי דעתו, כל אחד ואחד כפי בחינתו, כפי הממשלה והרבנות שיש לו, הן לרב או למעט
assignments.reason: This node describes the process of extracting true judgments and behavioral guidance from one's studies. Its essential nature is the practical application of Torah learning into righteous leadership and self-guidance — the domain of משפטי אמת and משפטי הנהגות ישרות (both Package 2 nodes). The text explicitly frames this as the opposite of משפט מעקל (Package 3). Every concept in this node — learning, extracting judgments, knowing how to guide self and others according to one's station — IS the practice of true judgment.

assignments.node_id: כשהתורה יש לה שלמות על ידי הספרים כנ"ל, אזי מקבלת מחכמה עלאה, בבחינת לוחות האבן, בחינת אבן שתיה. ואזי משפעת בכל החכמות
assignments.reason: This node describes the Torah, having been completed through the ספרים generated by controversy (Package 4's core process), now receiving from supernal wisdom and flowing into all wisdoms. While it references חכמה עלאה and אבן שתיה (Package 1), the essential nature of this node is the completed Torah as the bridge between controversy-renewal (Package 4) and the supernal intellect (Package 1). Its primary identity is as the culmination of Package 4's process — the Torah made complete through books — rather than the supernal wisdom itself. It IS the completed Torah, which is ספר in its fulfilled state.

The sweetening of all judgments (נמתקים כל הדינים) IS the same essential quality as המתקת הדינים (already in Package 1). The Torah states: 'all sweetening of all contractions and judgments is through the intellect... through supernal wisdom (חכמה עלאה), where all wisdoms are included, there all judgments are sweetened.' This is the cosmic function of the foundation stone/Holy of Holies (Package 1). The node names the outcome-state of Package 1's core purpose.

All souls being included together IS the gathering of נפשות (already in Package 1) within the tzaddik/foundation stone (צדיק הדור/אבן שתיה, Package 1). The Torah states: 'the stones of Jacob were all included within the foundation stone... the souls are stones... and they all come and are included within the tzaddik of the generation.' This node IS the collective soul-inclusion process that defines Package 1's soul-gathering function.

Joy (שמחה) in this Torah IS the state that emerges when individual candle-souls (נר/נפש, Package 1) unite into collective light (אור צדיקים). The Torah states: 'when they are included together, light is made from them, and through this joy is made — as in: the light of the righteous rejoices.' שמחה here is not an independent spiritual quality but the luminous expression of Package 1's soul-gathering: it IS what happens when the foundation stone's function is fulfilled. Its essential nature is the joy of the tzaddik (חדי רבי שמעון) that arises from the collective unity of souls — squarely within Package 1's domain.
